questions.question_hindi: एक प्रधानाचार्य एक अतिथि शिक्षक के चयन के लिए साक्षात्कार पैनल की अध्यक्षता कर रहे हैं। उम्मीदवारों की सूची की समीक्षा करते समय, प्रधानाचार्य को एहसास होता है कि उनके भाई-बहन के पति/पत्नी एक शॉर्टलिस्टेड आवेदक हैं। सबसे नैतिक कार्यवाही क्या होनी चाहिए?

चयन प्रक्रिया से खुद को अलग करें और उच्च अधिकारियों से वैकल्पिक अध्यक्ष नियुक्त करने का अनुरोध करें

questions.question_english: A Principal is chairing the interview panel for the selection of a guest teacher. Upon reviewing the candidate list, the Principal realizes that their sibling’s spouse is one of the shortlisted applicants. What is the most ethical course of action?
options_english: Inform the interview panel members privately while remaining as panel chairperson to ensure balanced scoring
Recuse themselves solely from interviewing and scoring that specific candidate while overseeing the rest of the candidates
Recuse themselves from the selection process and request higher authorities to appoint an alternate chairperson
Proceed with interviewing the relative normally while awarding them average marks to avoid any appearance of favoritism
questions.explanation_english: When a close relative applies for an advertised position, an administrator must immediately disclose the relationship and recuse themselves entirely from the selection process. Remaining on the panel or attempting to evaluate the relative creates an obvious conflict of interest and compromises selection integrity. Requesting an independent alternate chairperson ensures complete objectivity and public confidence.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (c) है। जब एक करीबी रिश्तेदार किसी विज्ञापित पद के लिए आवेदन करता है, तो एक प्रशासक को तुरंत संबंध का खुलासा करना चाहिए और चयन प्रक्रिया से पूरी तरह से खुद को अलग करना चाहिए। पैनल में बने रहना या रिश्तेदार का मूल्यांकन करने का प्रयास करना स्पष्ट रूप से हितों का टकराव पैदा करता है और चयन की अखंडता को कमजोर करता है। एक स्वतंत्र वैकल्पिक अध्यक्ष की मांग करना पूर्ण वस्तुनिष्ठता और सार्वजनिक विश्वास सुनिश्चित करता है।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (C) Recuse themselves from the selection process

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: When a close relative applies for an advertised position, an administrator must immediately disclose the relationship and recuse themselves entirely from the selection process.

questions.question_english: In the context of staff recruitment, the practice of appointing individuals to positions based on personal friendship rather than professional merit is specifically termed:
options_english: Cronyism
Nepotism
Patronage
Pluralism
questions.explanation_english: Cronyism refers specifically to the practice of appointing friends or associates to positions without regard to their objective qualifications or professional merit. In educational administration, cronyism compromises institutional quality, demoralizes qualified applicants, and undermines merit-based recruitment processes. It differs from nepotism, which specifically involves favoring family members or relatives in employment decisions.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (a) है। क्रोनीज़्म का तात्पर्य विशेष रूप से उन व्यक्तियों की नियुक्ति के अभ्यास से है जो मित्रों या सहयोगियों को उनकी वस्तुनिष्ठ योग्यताओं या पेशेवर योग्यता की परवाह किए बिना पदों पर नियुक्त करते हैं। शैक्षिक प्रशासन में, क्रोनीज़्म संस्थागत गुणवत्ता को कमजोर करता है, योग्य आवेदकों को निराश करता है, और योग्यता आधारित भर्ती प्रक्रियाओं को कमजोर करता है। यह नेपोटिज़्म से भिन्न है, जो विशेष रूप से रोजगार के निर्णयों में परिवार के सदस्यों या रिश्तेदारों को प्राथमिकता देने से संबंधित है।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (A) Cronyism

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: Cronyism refers specifically to the practice of appointing friends or associates to positions without regard to their objective qualifications or professional merit.

questions.question_english: Authentic leadership is an ethical model characterized by:
options_english: Replicating behavioral patterns demonstrated by historically prominent educational administrators
Concealing true thoughts to project an image of complete invulnerability to staff members
Strictly enforcing top-down authority without questioning organizational regulations
Self-awareness, relational transparency, moral perspective, and balanced processing
questions.explanation_english: Authentic leadership is defined by deep self-awareness, relational transparency, internalized moral perspective, and balanced decision-making processing. Authentic leaders act in accordance with genuine values, share information openly, solicit diverse perspectives, and build honest relationships with staff. This grounded approach builds trust, promotes workplace integrity, and models consistent ethical behavior across the organization.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (d) है। प्रामाणिक नेतृत्व गहरे आत्म-ज्ञान, संबंध पारदर्शिता, आंतरिक नैतिक दृष्टिकोण, और संतुलित निर्णय-निर्माण प्रक्रिया द्वारा परिभाषित किया जाता है। प्रामाणिक नेता वास्तविक मूल्यों के अनुसार कार्य करते हैं, जानकारी को खुलकर साझा करते हैं, विविध दृष्टिकोणों को आमंत्रित करते हैं, और स्टाफ के साथ ईमानदार संबंध बनाते हैं। यह ठोस दृष्टिकोण विश्वास का निर्माण करता है, कार्यस्थल की अखंडता को बढ़ावा देता है, और संगठन में लगातार नैतिक व्यवहार का मॉडल प्रस्तुत करता है।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (D) Self-awareness, relational transparency, moral perspective, and balanced processing

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: Authentic leadership is defined by deep self-awareness, relational transparency, internalized moral perspective, and balanced decision-making processing.

    III. प्रवेश स्तर के लिए यादृच्छिक लॉटरी प्रणाली सुनिश्चित करना निष्पक्षता को बढ़ावा देता है।

questions.question_english:
Evaluate the following statements regarding ethical conduct in school admissions:
    I. Deliberately withholding vacant seats to accommodate later requests from influential individuals violates integrity.
    II. Admitting a student in exchange for a 'voluntary' donation to the school's building fund is ethical if the funds are used solely for the school.
    III. Implementing a randomized lottery system for entry-level admissions promotes fairness.
    IV. Denying admission to a child with special needs due to the absence of ramps violates the principle of equity.
    Which of the above statements are correct?
options_english: I, II, and III only
I, III, and IV only
II, III, and IV only
I, II, III, and IV
questions.explanation_english: Withholding seats for influential individuals, failing to provide accessible infrastructure for children with special needs, and manipulating admissions violate principles of equity and integrity. Conversely, conducting randomized lottery draws for entry-level seats ensures fair and unbiased selection. Accepting donations in exchange for admission, even for institutional funds, constitutes illegal commercialization and severe ethical misconduct in admissions.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (b) है। प्रभावशाली व्यक्तियों के लिए सीटों को रोकना, विशेष आवश्यकताओं वाले बच्चों के लिए सुविधाओं का अभाव, और प्रवेश में हेरफेर करना समानता और अखंडता के सिद्धांतों का उल्लंघन करते हैं। दूसरी ओर, प्रवेश स्तर के लिए यादृच्छिक लॉटरी प्रणाली निष्पक्ष और पूर्वाग्रह रहित चयन सुनिश्चित करती है। प्रवेश के लिए दान स्वीकार करना, भले ही वह संस्थागत कोष के लिए हो, अवैध वाणिज्यीकरण और प्रवेश में गंभीर नैतिक misconduct का गठन करता है।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (B) I, III, and IV only

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: Withholding seats for influential individuals, failing to provide accessible infrastructure for children with special needs, and manipulating admissions violate equity and integrity.

I. Financial conflict (e.g., accepting a bribe).
II. Nepotism (e.g., hiring a family member).
III. Outside employment (e.g., running a business that sells to the school).
IV. Ideological conflict (e.g., favoring a political party in official school functions).
Which of the above are valid categories of conflict of interest in educational administration?

II, III, and IV only

questions.explanation_english: Conflicts of interest in school governance encompass financial improprieties, nepotism in staff selection, unauthorized external employment, and political bias in official functions. questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (d) है। हितों के टकराव की श्रेणियाँ वित्तीय अनियमितताओं, भाई-भतीजावाद, अनधिकृत बाहरी रोजगार और आधिकारिक समारोहों में राजनीतिक पूर्वाग्रह को शामिल करती हैं। ये सभी रूप प्रशासनिक तटस्थता और निर्णय लेने की वस्तुनिष्ठता को कमजोर करते हैं। इन विविध हितों के टकराव को पहचानना और समाप्त करना पारदर्शी प्रशासन, कानूनी अनुपालन, और सार्वजनिक शिक्षा में सार्वजनिक विश्वास बनाए रखने के लिए आवश्यक है।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (D) I, II, III, and IV

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: Conflicts of interest in school governance encompass financial improprieties, nepotism in staff selection, unauthorized external employment, and political bias in official functions.

questions.question_english: An ethical leader utilizing the 'Ethic of Critique' would most likely inquire about which of the following questions?

Who benefits from school policies, and who is marginalized by them?
What is the most administrative procedure to maintain student discipline?

questions.explanation_english: The Ethic of Critique focuses on examining institutional power structures, questioning underlying assumptions, and identifying social inequities embedded within operational rules. सभी माता-पिता से समान शुल्क योगदान की मांग करना

questions.question_english:
When a Principal establishes a Parent-Teacher
      Association (PTA) fund, the most critical ethical
      requirement is:
options_english:
To utilize gathered funds exclusively for
          administrative entertainment and social
          events

To maintain fund financial records
          confidentially away from general parent
          body review

To mandate identical fee contributions
          from all parents regardless of economic
          background

To ensure transparent accounting and fund
          use for student and school welfare
questions.explanation_english:
Managing Parent-Teacher Association funds
        requires strict financial transparency, detailed
        record-keeping, and explicit utilization of
        resources for student welfare and school
        development. PTA funds must be managed
        through joint, audited accounts accessible to
        stakeholder review. Transparent accounting
        prevents fund diversion, builds parental trust,
        and ensures financial contributions directly
        enhance institutional educational facilities.
questions.explanation_hindi:
सही उत्तर (d) है। माता-पिता-शिक्षक संघ के कोष का प्रबंधन
        सख्त वित्तीय पारदर्शिता, विस्तृत रिकॉर्ड-कीपिंग, और
        छात्र कल्याण और स्कूल विकास के लिए संसाधनों के स्पष्ट
        उपयोग की आवश्यकता होती है। PTA कोष का प्रबंधन संयुक्त,
        ऑडिट किए गए खातों के माध्यम से किया जाना चाहिए जो
        हितधारक समीक्षा के लिए सुलभ हों। पारदर्शी लेखा-जोखा
        कोष के विचलन को रोकता है, माता-पिता का विश्वास
        बनाता है, और सुनिश्चित करता है कि वित्तीय योगदान
        सीधे संस्थागत शैक्षणिक सुविधाओं को बढ़ाते हैं।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (D) To ensure transparent accounting and fund use for student and school welfare
Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: PTA funds must be managed through joint, audited accounts accessible to stakeholder review.

questions.question_english:
According to typical Codes of Conduct for teachers
      and heads of schools, engaging in private trade,
      business, or taking up secondary employment
      without prior sanction is:
options_english: Strongly encouraged in order to develop professional entrepreneurial skill sets
Prohibited due to conflict of interest and distraction from duties
Permitted provided the external business activity is related to education
Allowed provided all business operations occur exclusively on weekends
questions.explanation_english: Civil service conduct rules prohibit full-time educators and administrators from engaging in private business, commercial trades, or external employment without prior official sanction. Unauthorized secondary employment creates conflicts of commitment, diverts energy from primary instructional responsibilities, and risks corrupting professional objectivity. Regular duties require an educator’s undivided professional focus and commitment.

key_facts: Printed answer key: (B) Prohibited due to conflict of interest and

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: Civil service conduct rules prohibit full-time educators and administrators from engaging in private business, commercial trades, or external employment without prior official sanction.

questions.question_english: The concept of 'Slippery Slope' in administrative ethics suggests that:
options_english: Unpunished minor infractions lead to larger ethical violations over time
School corridors require installation of non-slip flooring materials
Operational ethical standards experience decline during rainy seasons
Delegated administrative tasks can never be reclaimed by leaders
questions.explanation_english: The 'slippery slope' concept in administrative ethics illustrates how ignoring minor rule infractions or small ethical compromises gradually normalizes deviance, leading to larger ethical violations over time. When minor misconduct is tolerated, moral standards erode across the organization. Leaders must address small ethical breaches promptly to prevent systemic corruption and maintain high institutional integrity.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (a) है। प्रशासनिक नैतिकता में 'स्लिपरी स्लोप' अवधारणा यह दर्शाती है कि छोटे नियम उल्लंघनों या छोटे नैतिक समझौतों की अनदेखी करना धीरे-धीरे विचलन को सामान्य बनाता है, जो समय के साथ बड़े नैतिक उल्लंघनों की ओर ले जाता है। जब छोटे अपराधों को सहन किया जाता है, तो संगठन में नैतिक मानक कमजोर होते हैं। नेताओं को छोटे नैतिक उल्लंघनों को तुरंत संबोधित करना चाहिए ताकि प्रणालीगत भ्रष्टाचार को रोका जा सके और उच्च संस्थागत अखंडता बनाए रखी जा सके।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (A) Unpunished minor infractions lead to larger ethical violations over time

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: The 'slippery slope' concept in administrative ethics illustrates how ignoring minor rule infractions or small ethical compromises gradually normalizes deviance, leading to larger ethical violations over time.

questions.question_english: The ethical paradigm of “Justice versus Mercy” is most vividly illustrated when a Principal has to decide whether to:
options_english: Enforce strict expulsion rules or offer a second chance due to troubled home life
Allocate remaining financial grants between expanding library facilities or upgrading science labs
Recruit a highly credentialed but arrogant instructor or a less qualified but respectful applicant
Adhere strictly to official arrival schedules or arrive late to campus due to personal commitments
questions.explanation_english: Choosing between enforcing strict disciplinary rules and showing compassion to a student facing personal hardships illustrates the justice versus mercy dilemma. Justice demands consistent rule enforcement and equal application of penalties, whereas mercy emphasizes individual understanding, compassion, and rehabilitation. Balancing these principles requires administrators to maintain order while considering human context.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (a) है। कठोर अनुशासनात्मक नियमों को लागू करने और व्यक्तिगत कठिनाइयों का सामना कर रहे छात्र के प्रति करुणा दिखाने के बीच चयन करना न्याय बनाम दया की दुविधा को दर्शाता है। न्याय लगातार नियमों के प्रवर्तन और दंडों के समान अनुप्रयोग की मांग करता है, जबकि दया व्यक्तिगत समझ, करुणा और पुनर्वास पर जोर देती है। इन सिद्धांतों का संतुलन बनाए रखना प्रशासनिक अधिकारियों के लिए आवश्यक है ताकि वे मानव संदर्भ पर विचार करते हुए व्यवस्था बनाए रख सकें।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (A) Enforce strict expulsion rules or offer a second chance due to troubled home life

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: Choosing between enforcing strict disciplinary rules and showing compassion to a student facing personal hardships illustrates the justice versus mercy dilemma.

questions.question_english: Which leadership model is fundamentally based on the ethical principle that the leader's primary role is to serve the needs of stakeholders (students, teachers, and community) rather than to accumulate power?
options_english: Servant Leadership
Transactional Leadership
Laissez-faire Leadership
Autocratic Leadership
questions.explanation_english: Servant leadership prioritizes the growth, well-being, and empowerment of stakeholders, including students, staff, and community members, over personal power accumulation. Leaders adopting this model view their primary responsibility as serving others, facilitating resource access, and supporting institutional needs. Fostering empathy and ethical stewardship creates an inclusive, highly supportive educational environment.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (a) है। सेवा नेतृत्व हितधारकों, जिसमें छात्र, स्टाफ और समुदाय के सदस्य शामिल हैं, की वृद्धि, भलाई और सशक्तिकरण को व्यक्तिगत शक्ति के संचय पर प्राथमिकता देता है। इस मॉडल को अपनाने वाले नेता अपनी प्राथमिक जिम्मेदारी को दूसरों की सेवा करने, संसाधनों की पहुंच को सुगम बनाने और संस्थागत आवश्यकताओं का समर्थन करने के रूप में देखते हैं। सहानुभूति और नैतिक प्रबंधन को बढ़ावा देना एक समावेशी, अत्यधिक सहायक शैक्षिक वातावरण बनाता है।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (A) Servant Leadership

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: Servant leadership prioritizes the growth, well-being, and empowerment of stakeholders, including students, staff, and community members, over personal power accumulation.

questions.question_english: 'Rule-based' thinking (Deontological ethics) in resolving a school administration dilemma would inquire:
options_english: Which decision produces maximum satisfaction for parent association members?
Would universal application of this rule create a better world?
How can leadership minimize financial costs during policy implementation?
What political ramifications might arise from selecting this option?
questions.explanation_english: Rule-based or deontological thinking evaluates choices by asking whether an action follows a moral duty that should become a universal rule for everyone to follow, regardless of short-term consequences. In school management, this principle guides administrators to act with consistency, truthfulness, and fairness, ensuring decisions set sound, repeatable precedents across the system.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (b) है। नियम-आधारित या डिओन्टोलॉजिकल सोच विकल्पों का मूल्यांकन करती है यह पूछकर कि क्या कोई क्रिया एक नैतिक कर्तव्य का पालन करती है जो सभी के लिए एक सार्वभौमिक नियम बनना चाहिए, चाहे तात्कालिक परिणाम कुछ भी हों। स्कूल प्रबंधन में, यह सिद्धांत प्रशासकों को निरंतरता, सत्यता, और निष्पक्षता के साथ कार्य करने के लिए मार्गदर्शन करता है, यह सुनिश्चित करते हुए कि निर्णय प्रणाली में ठोस, दोहराने योग्य मिसालें स्थापित करते हैं।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (B) Would universal application of this rule create a better world?

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: Rule-based or deontological thinking evaluates choices by asking whether an action follows a moral duty that should become a universal rule for everyone to follow, regardless of short-term consequences.
